nav.tagline: Your characters, your models, your rules.

hero.title: Choose your story
hero.subtitle: Characters to meet, worlds to explore, brought to life by the AI model of your choice, all running at home.

emptyState.title: The stage is empty
emptyState.before: Install a ready-to-play card from the
emptyState.after: , create your own, or import an existing card (JSON / PNG). Cards from other platforms are compatible.

importModal.title: Import a card
importModal.intro: Bring in a character or scenario made elsewhere. Cards follow the Character Card V2 format, which most roleplay tools read and write.
importModal.acceptsPng: A PNG card, artwork included. The card is read from inside the image.
importModal.acceptsJson: A JSON card exported from another tool.
importModal.acceptsLorebook: An attached lorebook comes along with it.
importModal.dropHint: or click to choose one. Several at once is fine.
importModal.sizeNote: Up to 15 MB per file. Nothing is uploaded anywhere: the file is read by your own copy of Evermind.

chatList.subtitle: Pick up your stories right where you left them.

emptyState.title: No stories yet
emptyState.body: Choose a character or scenario from the Discover tab to start your first conversation.

chatList.draftTooltip: An unfinished message is waiting in this conversation

personas.subtitle: Who are you in your stories?

emptyState.title: No personas
emptyState.body: Create an identity (name and description) that your characters will know during roleplay.

personas.descriptionHint: Appearance, personality, background: what your characters will know about you.
personas.useAsDefaultLabel: Use by default in new conversations

settings.subtitle: Your models, your rules: Evermind connects to the AI you choose.

emptyState.title: No connections
emptyState.body: Connect a local model (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, KoboldCpp) or an API (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic…). Without a connection, characters stay silent.

settings.replyLengthHint: Applies to every conversation. Remember to raise your connection's "Max response (tokens)" for long replies.
settings.historyLimitLabel: Recent messages sent to the model
settings.historyLimitHint: Beyond this, older turns only live on in the summary and established facts. Short window (16–30): the model stays focused on instructions instead of imitating its own replies. Long window: more raw continuity, but small models start to ramble.
settings.passageBudgetHint: Retrieves verbatim excerpts from older messages that are semantically related to the current scene (requires the "semantic" extra). ~1500 ≈ 10% of a 16k context. Set to 0 to disable. Every recall token is one less token of recent history.

autoMemoryHint.after: and updates the summary every ~6 replies. Facts stay visible and editable in each conversation's panel.

globalInstructionsHint.part1: Added to every conversation, after the character's rules. This is where you set
globalInstructionsHint.part3: limits: style, length, themes, language. Evermind imposes nothing.

settings.globalInstructionsPlaceholder:
E.g.: Always reply in English. Replies of 2 paragraphs maximum.
Stay dark and realistic, never ask my permission to move the story forward.

access.title: Access
access.hint: This device stays signed in until you sign it out or change the password.
access.logoutEverywhereConfirm: Every device, this one included, will have to enter the password again.

about.title: About
about.starHint: If Evermind is useful to you, starring the repository is what makes other people find it.
about.updateHint: Stop Evermind, then run this from the folder you installed it in.

zipHint.before: Downloaded as a ZIP, this copy is updated by hand:

about.builtHint: Built from the source, this image is updated by building it again from the new source:
about.checkHint: Ask GitHub whether a newer release exists each time this page opens. The request carries nothing you wrote, but GitHub sees what any website sees of a browser, including the address you opened Evermind at. With this off nothing goes out on its own, and the button below still works when you press it.
about.upToDate: You are on the newest release.

connections.apiKeySetHint: Saved ({hint}), leave blank to keep it.
connections.benchmarkHint: A small real generation to measure latency and throughput
connections.contextSizeHint: Match it exactly to the context size served by your server, otherwise your conversations get truncated without warning.
connections.maxTokensHint: A ceiling, not a target: style is set in Settings → Reply length.
connections.temperatureHint: Lower = more coherent. 0.8 is a good balance for roleplay.

errors.nothingAdded: The model had nothing to add to this reply.

narrate.label: Narration: you describe the world, the scene, the events
narrate.placeholder: Describe the scene, the world, an event…

ooc.label: Out-of-character instruction: a note for the AI, invisible in the story
ooc.placeholder: Instruction for the AI (e.g.: always finish your sentences)…

input.ghostwriteTitle: Write my reply for me (editable before sending)
input.ghostwriteError: Could not write your reply for you.
input.hintDefault: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · quill: the AI drafts your reply
input.hintTouch: Tap send when you are ready. The quill drafts your reply.

message.confirmDeleteFrom: Delete this message and all that follow?

directive.title: Scene directive
directive.description: A standing instruction reminded to the AI on every reply. It's the strongest lever for correcting a stubborn tic ("always finish your sentences", "vary your phrasing", "stay explicit"…).
directive.placeholder: E.g.: every reply must be a complete sentence, never leave a character hanging mid-thought.

summary.title: Story summary
summary.placeholder: Updated automatically by memory; freely editable. Injected into every turn.

facts.title: Established facts
facts.consolidateTitle: Merge redundant facts into a denser set
facts.extractTitle: Read the latest turns now: record new facts and update the summary
facts.description: Canon the character must not contradict. Pinned facts are always sent to the model; the others only once their turn has left the recent messages, and within a budget. Extracted automatically as the story goes.
facts.summaryOnly: No new facts; the summary was updated.

wallpaper.title: Backdrop
wallpaper.description: An image behind this conversation. It belongs to this conversation alone, not to the character.

writing.title: Writing
writing.modes: The button left of the box switches between speaking, narrating the scene yourself, and a note meant for the AI rather than the story.

modelSilent.title: No answer from the model.
modelSilent.hint: The AI server behind this conversation may not be running.

form.taglineHint: A catchy sentence, shown on the card.
form.descriptionHint: Who is this character? Appearance, backstory, way of speaking. Use {{char}} and {{user}}.
form.startingSituationHint: The context at the start of the conversation.
form.greetingHint: The message that opens the scene. *actions* in asterisks.
form.worldHint: The world, the plot, the characters the AI will play as narrator.
form.toneHint: The story's mood: dark, epic, romantic…
form.openingSceneHint: The narration that kicks off the adventure.
form.alternateGreetingsEmptyHint: Optional: other scene openings, swappable with the first message.
form.exampleDialoguesHint: Show the writing style. Separate each example with <START>. Macros {{char}} / {{user}}.
form.exampleDialoguesPlaceholder:
<START>
{{user}}: Are you okay?
{{char}}: *She dusted off her cloak.* Define "okay."
form.systemPromptHint: Replaces Evermind's default roleplay rules. {{original}} re-injects them.
form.postHistoryHint: Injected after the history, as close as possible to generation (the "post-history instructions" field of V2 cards).
form.creatorNotesHint: Visible on the card, never sent to the model.
form.exportError: The card could not be exported.

assist.heading: AI-assisted creation
assist.briefPlaceholderCharacter: Describe the character you want: who they are, mood, relationship with you, starting situation… The AI fills in the whole card, you adjust it afterward.
assist.briefPlaceholderScenario: Describe the adventure you want: setting, mood, the player's role, stakes… The AI fills in the whole card, you adjust it afterward.
assist.connectionSelectTitle: Model used to write the card
assist.fieldsKeptHint: Fields already filled in are kept.
assist.gone: The result is no longer there. Press Generate to start again.
assist.statusWaiting: Waiting for the model's first word…
assist.statusThinking: The model is thinking… {chars} characters so far.
assist.connectionWait: Waiting for the connection… the card keeps being written meanwhile.
assist.missing: Still missing: {fields}. Press Generate again to write only what is missing.
assist.missingCut: The model ran out of room before the end. Missing: {fields}. Press Generate again to write only what is missing.
assist.missingStopped: Stopped before the end. Missing: {fields}. Press Generate again to write only what is missing.

lorebook.title: Lorebook
lorebook.description: World knowledge injected only when its keywords appear in the scene. Exported with the card (standard format).
lorebook.contentPlaceholder: What the model should know when these words appear…
lorebook.entryRequiredError: An entry needs at least one keyword and some content.

startChatModal.title: Join {name}
startChatModal.personaHint: Manage your identities in the Personas tab.
startChatModal.noConnectionWarning: Set up an LLM connection in Settings first (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Anthropic…). You choose.

libraryModal.description: Ready-to-play cards, bundled with Evermind. Install, edit, delete: they become yours.
libraryModal.emptyState: The library is empty (library/ folder missing).

errors.unreachable: Evermind is not answering. Is it still running?
errors.notSent: This message was not sent. Press Send to send it again.
errors.invalid: Evermind could not accept this: something in it is missing or not valid.
errors.textTooLong: This text is too long: it has {length} characters and the limit is {limit}.
errors.textTooShort: This text is too short: it needs at least {limit} characters.
errors.textTooShort_one: This text cannot be left empty.
errors.briefTooLong: This text is too long for this model: with the assistant's instructions, what the card already holds and room for its answer, it needs about {needed:grouped} tokens, and the connection holds {context:grouped}. Shorten it, raise the connection's context in Settings if the model can take more, or choose a connection with a larger context.
errors.cardTooLong: What this card already holds is too long for this model: with the assistant's instructions and room for its answer, it needs about {needed:grouped} tokens, and the connection holds {context:grouped}. Shorten the card's longest fields, raise the connection's context in Settings if the model can take more, or choose a connection with a larger context.
errors.contextTooSmall: This model's context is too small for the card assistant: its instructions and room for a card alone need about {needed:grouped} tokens, and the connection holds {context:grouped}. Raise the connection's context in Settings if the model can take more, or choose a connection with a larger context.
errors.locked: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.tooLarge: Too long to be the password, or a reverse proxy passed it on without saying its length.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.crossOrigin: Evermind refused this request because it seems to come from another address. Behind a reverse proxy, the proxy has to pass the original Host header on unchanged.
errors.unknownHost: Without a password, Evermind does not answer to this name. Open it by its address (such as http://192.168.1.42:3000) or by localhost, or set a password.
errors.pngWithoutCard: This PNG image does not contain a character card.
errors.unrecognizedCardFile: This file is not a card. Choose a JSON card or a PNG card.
errors.variantOutOfRange: That variant of the reply does not exist.
errors.memoryBusy: Another memory task is running. Nothing was altered; try again in a moment.
errors.factsChanged: The facts changed while the model was working with them. Nothing was kept; try again.
errors.conversationChanged: The conversation changed while the model was reading it. Nothing was kept; try again.
errors.tooFewFacts: Too few facts to condense: only the ones the model wrote and nobody pinned are merged.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large (15 MB at most).
errors.unsupportedImage: This image format is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.conversationEmpty: This conversation has no messages yet.
errors.noConnection: No LLM connection is set up. Add one in Settings → LLM connections.
errors.modelUnreachable: Evermind cannot reach the model's server at {message}. Check that it is running and that the address in the connection is right.
errors.turnRunning: A reply is already being written, so this was not sent.
errors.modelEmpty: The model returned an empty reply. Try again or switch models.
errors.modelUnreadable: The model's answer could not be read. Try again.
errors.modelOnlyThought: The model spent its whole answer thinking and wrote nothing. Raise the connection's max tokens, or use a model that does not think as long.
errors.modelAuthRefused: The model's server refused the API key. Check the key in the connection. The server said: {message}
errors.modelNotFound: The model's server does not know this address or this model. Check the URL and the model name in the connection. The server said: {message}
errors.modelRateLimited: The model's server has reached its rate limit. Try again shortly. The server said: {message}
errors.modelNetworkError: The model took too long to answer, or the connection to its server broke.
errors.modelNoText: The model did not produce any text.
errors.nothingToRegenerate: There is no reply to regenerate yet. Send a message first.
errors.nothingToContinue: The last message is not a reply, so there is nothing to continue.

login.cookieRefused: Your browser did not keep the sign-in. Allow cookies for this address and try again.
